Use Pisah vs Gabung Harta in your AI

Install one skill in Claude, ChatGPT or Grok, then ask your question in plain words. Your AI looks up what you did not say, lists every assumption with its source, and replies with one link that opens Pisah vs Gabung Harta on your scenario. The tool works out the answer, so the figures you see are the tool's, not the chatbot's.

⬇ Download brotools-pisahvsgabung.zip Open the tool

A .zip skill: SKILL.md (how to answer), references/ (every input, its range and the Quick Starts) and scripts/build_link.py (builds and checks the link). Read SKILL.md

Install the skill

Pick your assistant. The demo plays the steps; press a step to jump to it.

    Menus move as these apps update; look for Skills in Settings. Skills need the app's code tool switched on (Claude: Code execution and file creation). No skill support on your plan? Attach brotools-pisahvsgabung.zip or SKILL.md to the chat and say "use this skill".

    How to use it

    Ask as you would ask a friend. With the skill on, the AI keeps your figures, researches the rest, and hands you the link. It does not give the answer itself: the tool does, once you open the link.

    pakai tool.adjiebrotots.com/pisahvsgabung, suami gaji Rp 25 juta sebulan, istri Rp 18 juta, punya 2 anak: lebih hemat pisah harta atau gabung?

    Using skill brotools-pisahvsgabung Ran scripts/build_link.py: link checked

    Assumptions

    1. Rumah tangga: dua penghasilan, jadi tautan dimulai dari Quick Start Double income family (qs=double), yang mengisi gaji suami dan gaji istri sendiri-sendiri, dengan PTKP dan lapisan tarif sesuai ketentuan.
    2. Gaji setahun: suami Rp 300,000,000 (Rp 25 juta dikali 12) dan istri Rp 216,000,000 (Rp 18 juta dikali 12), karena alat ini memakai gaji kotor setahun. THR, gaji ke-13, dan bonus tidak disebutkan, jadi tidak ditambahkan.
    3. Tanggungan: 2 anak, sesuai yang disebutkan.
    4. Pengurang seperti iuran pensiun tidak disebutkan, jadi tetap Rp 0 untuk suami dan Rp 0 untuk istri. Biaya jabatan tetap dihitung otomatis.

    Open this scenario
    • Your figures stay yours. Anything you state goes in as you said it; correct any assumption and the AI sends a new link.
    • Checked before you see it. The skill's script knows every input, its range and its choices, so the link opens exactly the scenario listed.
    • The tool shows what the AI chose. When the link opens, a banner lists each value the AI set and why, with an Undo back to your own inputs.
